recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes the published FHIR-5471 example request using current DiagnosticReport.basedOn and ServiceRequest.requisition modeling without changing unrelated DiagnosticReport semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-5471 was a Published/Persuasive OO ballot comment for FHIR-core DiagnosticReport. It asked how requests, results, and specimens relate when they appear at the same level and requested extending DiagnosticReport examples to show more than one request, with diagnosticreport-example-ghp named in the resolution.
initial_application: Git commit be15b4bd48b0f4a6958edb6e43fd73a33c47d55a pre-applied #5471 by adding the GHP example. Current history retained and refactored that example, but before this reconciliation it still had zero DiagnosticReport.basedOn references and no bundled ServiceRequest resources.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini and the GHP example is listed in source/diagnosticreport/list-DiagnosticReport-examples.xml. Current DiagnosticReport.basedOn is 0..* and targets ServiceRequest, while ServiceRequest.requisition links independent requests ordered together. A 2020 Zulip discussion of the GHP example also supports ServiceRequest as the order-level structure for preserving panel grouping; no Confluence reference for FHIR-5471 was found.
reconciliation: Added three DiagnosticReport.basedOn references to separate ServiceRequest resources for chemistry, CBC, and urinalysis in the GHP example Bundle. Each ServiceRequest has its own placer identifier and shares a common requisition. Updated the examples list description to say the GHP example covers multiple specimens, requests, and panels.
source_changes: source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-example-ghp.xml: added three basedOn references and three bundled ServiceRequest resources for the GHP chemistry, CBC, and urinalysis requests.
source/diagnosticreport/list-DiagnosticReport-examples.xml: updated the GHP example description to mention multiple requests.
